'''Pickled toadstools''' are the preservation of the red [[mushroom]]: a splash potion of {{EffectLink|Poison}} II lasting 1 minute.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/pickled_red_mushrooms.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A raw red mushroom, a brown mushroom and a glass bottle. Obtaining a [[Braised Toadstool|braised toadstool]] unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Throwing ===
It can't be eaten. Like a splash potion, it is thrown and applies Poison II for up to 1:00 to every creature in the splash, at full duration for a direct hit and shorter further out. The tooltip marks it as throwable.
